opennyai_summary.decision:
Learned counsel for the appellants has filed a memo for withdrawal of the appeal on the ground that, it is a double appeal against the same judgment and further, the appellant may be permitted to prosecute the other appeal in MFA No.201522/2023.
The memo is taken on record.
The appeal is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as sought for.
